# cpanel_ip_block (Data Source)

Looks up one cPanel IP address, CIDR prefix, or address-range block.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cpanel_ip_block" "office" {
  address = "203.0.113.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The IP address, CIDR prefix, or `start-end` range to look up.

### Read-Only

- `end_address` (String) The normalized last address in the blocked range.
- `start_address` (String) The normalized first address in the blocked range.
